title: Sulfhydryl modified silver-titanium oxide to effectively and stably promote the electrocatalytic reduction of carbon dioxide to CO
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2238-2247
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01688B, Paper
Qian Zhang, Chenyu Yan, Zheng Tang, Ya Zhang, Honggui Wang
Sulfhydryl-modified silver-titanium oxides exhibited efficient and stable electrocatalytic performance in the electrocatalytic CO2RR. This work provides a feasible method for the rational design of effective silver-based titanium oxide catalysts.
